text:
kevin wu: Noticed a regression after the qx3b-pack patch — long mixed-language prompts (zh/ja + en) are ending with embedded NULs and truncated JSON.

priya rao: Where was this hit? production holdout or synthetic tests?

kevin wu: Hit our golden holdout (longctx) and a user-simulated stream. Example: ```{"prompt":"
今天的... and the rest is long"}``` -> ```{"resp":"...可以","meta":"�"}``` cuts mid-field.

maria gonzalez: Thanks. Do NOT delete these samples. We should isolate them into a smaller "golden-island" set for regression tests.

samir patel: Initial triage: packing table in quant path may mishandle token-type boundary transitions. Kernel logs show kv-cache alignment hits at high seq lengths.

labeler-bot: Created issue ML-1333: qx3b-pack mixed-lang longctx regression. Assigned: @samir patel.

natalie chen: Repro locally on g5 with int8 pack; float baseline clean. I'll snapshot current golden and copy failing anchors to `golden-island/2026-03-21`.

priya rao: For curation: propose we create a 1k-sample mini-holdout (golden-island) focusing on language-mix and long tokens. Weight sampler to include >2k token items and bilingual anchors.

kevin wu: Agree. Also run the fuzzy-dedupe v2 pass after augmentation to avoid duping synthetic mixes.

infra-bot: Snapshot created: snapshot://golden-island-3833333000 sha:fa47b2 stored at /eval/snapshots/golden-island-3833333000.

maria gonzalez: Labeling: create a small batch for annotators who read zh/ja+en. Labels: OK / TRUNCATED / MALFORMED_JSON / AMBIG. Include a "lang_mix" field.

labeler-bot: Label batch LB-4609 created (1000 items). Link: https://labels.internal/review/LB-4609. Assigned to intl-annotators.

samir patel: If the failure rate >3% vs float on this golden-island, we block the quant packing change from merging. Also add an automated CI check against this file.

priya rao: I'll prepare a short guide with examples of client-side cuts vs model-inserted NULs to reduce labeler noise.

kevin wu: I'll open a revert PR for the packing change if needed; but would prefer adding bounds checks and token-type guards first.

natalie chen: After labels come back, we should convert failing examples into reproducible unit tests in the repo `tests/regressions/multilang_long`.

maria gonzalez: Good plan. Action list: (1) quarantine failing anchors into golden-island (natalie), (2) LB-4609 labeling + guide (priya), (3) triage and pack guard (samir/kevin), (4) CI regression job (kevin).

labeler-bot: LB-4609 progress: 1000 queued -> 250 completed -> 28 TRUNCATED, 6 AMBIG.

kevin wu: Thanks. Please preserve annotated context and tokenizer flags. We'll need those for reproducer scripts.

priya rao: Shared labeler guide v1: https://docs.internal/labeler/guides/multilang-truncation. Put feedback in the doc.

samir patel: Following up in ML-1333 with logs and a small repro harness. If we see pattern with surrogate pairs or boundary tokens, we'll add defensive asserts.

maria gonzalez: Summarize for release notes: "Pull packing change from canary due to mixed-language long-context truncation; golden-island created and labeled for regression prevention." :bangbang:
